固定源码 data/talents/psionic/psionic.lua:45（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：
newTalentType{… type="psionic/nightmare", name=_t("nightmare", "talent type"), description=_t"**Manifest** your enemies nightmares." }
manifest 意为「使……具现、化为实体」，而非使人陷入某种状态。**源码可直接印证**：该系天赋确实把噩梦召唤成实体生物——data/talents/psionic/nightmare.lua:243 起的 Night Terror 含 summonNightTerror，内部 local NPC = require "mod.class.NPC"、m = NPC.new{… ai="summoned" …}；:91 起的 Inner Demons 含 summon_inner_demons，内部 m = target:cloneActor{… summoner=self, summon_time=10 …}。即玩家面对的是被召唤出来的噩梦生物，不是单纯的负面状态。
**与邻近天赋系撞义（决定性）**：译文「使你的敌人陷入噩梦。」描述的是「令敌人进入某状态」，而同文件 :47 的 slumber 系 description 为 "Force enemies into a deep sleep."，本库译作「使敌人进入昏睡。」（mod-tome.lua:27831）。两条天赋系说明在译文里几乎同义，玩家在天赋树界面无法区分「梦魇」（召唤噩梦实体攻击）与「沉睡」（强制入睡）这两个机制完全不同的系。
判 confirmed，需修复：应作「将敌人的噩梦具现化。」一类，保留 manifest 的具现义并与 slumber 系拉开区分。

固定源码 game/modules/tome/init.lua（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）load_tips 条目，原文为：
"Stunning an opponent slows down their movement and reduces their damage output, giving you the opportunity to **tactically reposition** or **finish them off at less risk**."
后半句给出**两条并列**的战术建议：(a) 利用控制间隙**进行战术走位／重新占位**；(b) **以更低风险**将其终结。
译文「震慑可以减缓目标的移动速度，降低其伤害输出，这样可以为你制造机会解决它们，或者降低他们对你的威胁。」两处偏离：
(1) **(a) 整条被删**：tactically reposition 在译文中无任何对应成分，这条新手提示丢失了一半战术内容；
(2) **(b) 被改写且风险方错置**：at less risk 限定的是**玩家所承担的风险**；译文剥离该限定后补入源文没有的「降低他们对你的威胁」，把风险归属从玩家改成敌人威胁度，而「降低威胁」与前半句已述的「减缓移动、降低伤害输出」重复，等于用一句重复话替换掉了原有信息。
本串是**新手提示（load_tips）**，面向最不熟悉机制的玩家，信息完整性尤其重要。
判 confirmed，需修复：应补回「进行战术走位」并把 at less risk 还原为玩家侧风险，如「……为你制造机会重新占位，或以更低的风险将其解决」。

description = [[
Welcome to Maj'Eyal.

This is the Age of Ascendancy. After over ten thousand years of strife, pain and chaos the known world is at last at relative peace.
The last effects of the #FF0000#Spellblaze#WHITE# have been tamed. The land slowly heals itself and the civilisations rebuild themselves after the Age of Pyre.

It has been one hundred and twenty-two years since the Allied Kingdoms were established under the rule of #14fffc#Toknor#ffffff# and his wife #14fffc#Mirvenia#ffffff#.
Together they ruled the kingdoms with fairness and brought prosperity to both Halflings and Humans.
The King died of old age fourteen years ago, and his son #14fffc#Tolak#ffffff# is now King.

The Elven kingdoms are quiet. The Shaloren Elves in their home of Elvala are trying to make the world forget about their role in the Spellblaze and are living happy lives under the leadership of #14fffc#Aranion Gayaeil#ffffff#.
The Thaloren Elves keep to their ancient tradition of living in the woods, ruled as always by #14fffc#Nessilla Tantaelen#ffffff# the wise.

The Dwarves of the Iron Throne have maintained a careful trade relationship with the Allied Kingdoms for nearly one hundred years, yet not much is known about them, not even their leader's name.

While the people of Maj'Eyal know that the mages helped put an end to the terrors of the Spellblaze, they also did not forget that it was magic that started those events. As such, mages are still shunned from society, if not outright hunted down.
Still, this is a golden age. Civilisations are healing the wounds of thousands of years of conflict, and the Humans and the Halflings have made a lasting peace.

You are an adventurer, set out to discover wonders, explore old places, and venture into the unknown for wealth and glory.
]]

-- Define the fields that are sync'ed online, and how they are sync'ed
profile_defs = {
	allow_build = { {name="index:string:50"}, receive=function(data, save) save[data.name] = true end, export=function(env) for k, _ in pairs(env) do add{name=k} end end },
	lore = { {name="index:string:30"}, receive=function(data, save) save.lore = save.lore or {} save.lore[data.name] = true end, export=function(env) for k, v in pairs(env.lore or {}) do add{name=k} end end },
	escorts = { incr_only=true, {fate="index:enum(lost,betrayed,zigur,saved)"}, {nb="number"}, receive=function(data, save) inc_set(save, data.fate, data, "nb") end, export=function(env) for k, v in pairs(env) do add{fate=k, nb=v} end end },
	artifacts = { incr_only=true, {cid="index:string:50"}, {name="index:string:40"}, {nb="number"}, receive=function(data, save) save.artifacts = save.artifacts or {} save.artifacts[data.cid] = save.artifacts[data.cid] or {} inc_set(save.artifacts[data.cid], data.name, data, "nb") end, export=function(env) for cid, d in pairs(env.artifacts or {}) do for name, v in pairs(d) do add{cid=cid, name=name, nb=v} end end end },
	characters = { incr_only=true, {cid="index:string:50"}, {nb="number"}, receive=function(data, save) save.characters = save.characters or {} inc_set(save.characters, data.cid, data, "nb") end, export=function(env) for k, v in pairs(env.characters or {}) do add{cid=k, nb=v} end end },
	uniques = { incr_only=true, {cid="index:string:50"}, {victim="index:string:50"}, {nb="number"}, receive=function(data, save) save.uniques = save.uniques or {} save.uniques[data.cid] = save.uniques[data.cid] or {} inc_set(save.uniques[data.cid], data.victim, data, "nb") end, export=function(env) for cid, d in pairs(env.uniques or {}) do for name, v in pairs(d) do add{cid=cid, victim=name, nb=v} end end end },
	deaths = { incr_only=true, {cid="index:string:50"}, {source="index:string:50"}, {nb="number"}, receive=function(data, save) save.sources = save.sources or {} save.sources[data.cid] = save.sources[data.cid] or {} inc_set(save.sources[data.cid], data.source, data, "nb") end, export=function(env) for cid, d in pairs(env.sources or {}) do for name, v in pairs(d) do add{cid=cid, source=name, nb=v} end end end },
	achievements = { {id="index:string:40"}, {gained_on="timestamp"}, {who="string:50"}, {turn="number"}, receive=function(data, save) save[data.id] = {who=data.who, when=data.gained_on, turn=data.turn} end, export=function(env) for id, v in pairs(env) do add{id=id, who=v.who, gained_on=v.when, turn=v.turn} end end },
	donations = { no_sync=true, {last_ask="timestamp"}, receive=function(data, save) save.last_ask = data.last_ask end, export=function(env) add{last_ask=env.last_ask} end },
	scores = {
		no_sync=true,
		receive=function(data,save)
			save.sc = save.sc or {}
			save.sc[data.world] = save.sc[data.world] or {}
			save.sc[data.world].alive = save.sc[data.world].alive or {}
			save.sc[data.world].dead = save.sc[data.world].dead or {}
			if data.type == "alive" then
				save.sc[data.world].alive = save.sc[data.world].alive or {}
				save.sc[data.world].alive[data.name] = data
			else
				-- clear any 'alive' entry with this name
				save.sc[data.world].alive[data.name] = nil
				save.sc[data.world].dead = save.sc[data.world].dead or {}
				save.sc[data.world].dead[#save.sc[data.world].dead+1] = data
			end
		end
	},
}

译文「……并根据你当前生效的毒素造成**中毒效果**」有两处偏离：
**(1) 开放语义被窄化为单一 DoT，与源码实现不符。** 沿 Venomous Strike 调用链核查 data/talents/cunning/poisons.lua:290 name="Venomous Strike"、:322-353 applyVenomousEffects，五种毒素的附加效果**只有一种是中毒**：

· Volatile Poison → :349-352 以目标为中心 radius=nb 的**范围自然伤害爆发**
把这一整组说成「中毒效果」，玩家会据此低估该技能并误判毒素搭配。
**(2) vile 限定丢失。** 原文 active **vile** poisons 特指该类毒素（同文件 :31 cancelPoisons 以 t.vile_poison 判定），译文「当前生效的毒素」把来源范围放大到所有毒素。

surface 报「将梦境之种从 %s 沉睡的意识中逸出误译成『从 %s 的沉眠中释放』，遗漏了 mind」，交叉复核判 OK。宿主判 **advisory、本批不修复**。
固定源码 data/general/npcs/horror.lua:758-765（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：该 AI 分支先 game.zone:addEntity(game.level, m, "actor", x, y) 生成一个梦境之种实体并播放传送粒子，随后 game.logSeen(self, "#LIGHT_BLUE#A dream seed escapes %s's **sleeping mind**.", …)。
指控属实：(1) sleeping **mind**（沉睡的**意识**）在译文中只剩「沉眠」，丢掉了「意识」这一层——对梦魇类怪物而言，梦境之种源自其心灵正是设定重点；(2) escapes（自行逸出）被译为「释放」（被动／使役），施动方向由种子自身改为被释放。
但本串是一条战斗日志提示，无任何机制信息，也不影响玩家判断（实体已同时生成并可见）；按既定门槛（无机制后果的意象/施动取舍不上升为必修缺陷），记为 advisory。若日后润色，宜作「一颗梦境之种自 %s 沉睡的意识中逸出。」

surface 报「smeared 被译为『时空转化』，含义无关」。**此报未考虑本库既定天赋名，予以 refuted**，与交叉复核的 OK 同向。
固定源码 data/talents/chronomancy/other.lua:613-617（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：
local smear = dam * t.getPercent(self, t)；self:setEffect(self.**EFF_DAMAGE_SMEARING**, t.getDuration(self, t), {dam=smear/t.getDuration(self, t), …})；game:delayedLogDamage(src, self, 0, ("%s(%d **smeared**)#LAST#"):tformat(…, smear), false)
即本串是 **Damage Smearing 天赋触发时的飘字**，smeared 的数值就是被该天赋摊分到后续回合的伤害量，这里的 smeared 是对天赋名的回指，而非独立的形容词。
**本库既定译名实测**：mod-tome.lua:22232 t("Damage Smearing", "**时空转化**", **talent name**)，另 :36503 同名效果亦作「时空转化」。本条飘字 :22233 用「时空转化」正是复用该天赋名，使玩家一眼看出这串数字由哪个天赋产生——这是飘字文案的常规做法，并非「含义无关」。
（附：Damage Smearing→时空转化 这一译名本身偏离字面 smear 的「涂抹／摊分」义，但那是既定天赋名的选择问题，且已在全库一致使用，不属本条缺陷；若日后重审天赋名，两处须同批处理。）

固定源码 game/modules/tome/init.lua（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）load_tips 条目，原文为：
"Stunning an opponent slows down their movement and reduces their damage output, giving you the opportunity to **tactically reposition** or **finish them off at less risk**."
后半句给出**两条并列**的战术建议：(a) 利用控制间隙**进行战术走位／重新占位**；(b) **以更低风险**将其终结。
译文「震慑可以减缓目标的移动速度，降低其伤害输出，这样可以为你制造机会解决它们，或者降低他们对你的威胁。」两处偏离：
(1) **(a) 整条被删**：tactically reposition 在译文中无任何对应成分，这条新手提示丢失了一半战术内容；
(2) **(b) 被改写且风险方错置**：at less risk 限定的是**玩家所承担的风险**；译文剥离该限定后补入源文没有的「降低他们对你的威胁」，把风险归属从玩家改成敌人威胁度，而「降低威胁」与前半句已述的「减缓移动、降低伤害输出」重复，等于用一句重复话替换掉了原有信息。
本串是**新手提示（load_tips）**，面向最不熟悉机制的玩家，信息完整性尤其重要。
判 confirmed，需修复：应补回「进行战术走位」并把 at less risk 还原为玩家侧风险，如「……为你制造机会重新占位，或以更低的风险将其解决」。

固定源码 data/talents/techniques/throwing-knives.lua:391-394 的 info（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：
"Throw a knife coated with venom, doing %d%% damage as nature and inflicting **additional effects** based on your active **vile** poisons (as per the Venomous Strike talent)"
译文「……并根据你当前生效的毒素造成**中毒效果**」有两处偏离：
**(1) 开放语义被窄化为单一 DoT，与源码实现不符。** 沿 Venomous Strike 调用链核查 data/talents/cunning/poisons.lua:290 name="Venomous Strike"、:322-353 applyVenomousEffects，五种毒素的附加效果**只有一种是中毒**：
· Insidious Poison → :328 施加 EFF_POISONED（唯一的中毒）
· Numbing Poison → :329 施加 EFF_SLOW（**减速**）
· Crippling Poison → :330-347 把目标可用主动技能压入 target.talents_cd（**技能冷却干扰**）
· Leeching Poison → :348 self:heal(heal, t)（**施法者自疗，根本不作用于目标**）
· Volatile Poison → :349-352 以目标为中心 radius=nb 的**范围自然伤害爆发**
把这一整组说成「中毒效果」，玩家会据此低估该技能并误判毒素搭配。
**(2) vile 限定丢失。** 原文 active **vile** poisons 特指该类毒素（同文件 :31 cancelPoisons 以 t.vile_poison 判定），译文「当前生效的毒素」把来源范围放大到所有毒素。
判 confirmed，需修复：应作「……根据你当前生效的**恶毒**毒素造成**相应的附加效果**（同毒素爆发）」，不得把 additional effects 收窄为「中毒效果」。

	end

	end
	return combat
end

local function throw(self, range, dam, x, y, dtype, special, fok)
	local eff = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_THROWING_KNIVES)
	if not eff and not fok then return nil end
	self.turn_procs.quickdraw = true
	local tg = {speed = 10, type="bolt", range=range, selffire=false, display={display='', particle="arrow", particle_args={tile="particles_images/rogue_throwing_knife"} }}
	game:playSoundNear(self, {"actions/knife_throw", vol=0.8})
	local proj = self:projectile(tg, x, y, function(px, py, tg, self)
		local target = game.level.map(px, py, engine.Map.ACTOR)
		if target and target ~= self then
			local hits = table.get(target.turn_procs, "hit_by_throwing_knife") or 0
			if hits and hits >= 5 then return end
			table.set(target.turn_procs, "hit_by_throwing_knife", hits + 1)
			local t = self:getTalentFromId(self.T_THROWING_KNIVES)
			local t2 = self:getTalentFromId(self.T_PRECISE_AIM)
			local combat = t.getKnives(self, t)
			local hit = self:attackTargetWith(target, combat, dtype, dam)
			if hit then

			elseif combat.sound_miss then game:playSoundNear(self, combat.sound_miss) end
		end
	end)
	if not fok then

		if eff.stacks <= 0 then self:removeEffect(self.EFF_THROWING_KNIVES) end
	end
	return proj
